criterion: Error messages: specific, actionable / Network failure
description: When the invitation's embedded hub address is unreachable from this computer (loopback endpoint, no --public-url), linking fails with "Project authority unavailable; retry this attempt" and "Retry when it is back; nothing was lost." Retrying can never succeed, and the real cause (the invitation points at an address this computer cannot reach) is never named.
expected: Distinguish 'the hub is down' from 'this invitation points at a loopback/unreachable address'; for loopback endpoints, say the inviting computer must be started with a public URL and issue a new invitation.
actual: Identical retry-forever message on every attempt.
suggested_fix: Detect loopback endpoints on redeem (and refuse at creation, see F-015-02) and map them to a dedicated code and hint.

description: Creating a My device invitation on a client with no public URL gives no warning that the invitation will only work on this same computer.
expected: A warning in the dialog (and CLI) that another computer cannot reach this client, and how to fix it.
actual: The dialog shows the normal 'Waiting to be used' state; the CLI returns success.
suggested_fix: Expose the endpoint reachability in the invite API and show a warning when it is loopback.

description: After Create invitation, the dialog shows the same invitation's status, expiry and Revoke twice: in the active-invitation block and again in the history row below. The history pill "Waiting to be used" also wraps onto two lines.
expected: The history list omits (or merges with) the invitation shown above, and the status pill stays on one line.
actual: "Waiting to be used · Expires in 24 h · Nov 10, 11:05 AM" plus Revoke, repeated in the history row.
suggested_fix: Hide the current invitation from the history list while it is shown above, or drop the top block and act on the row.

description: After Show invite text, the dialog still says "The invitation stays hidden so it can't be read from a shared screen." directly above the warning "Visible on screen. Stop sharing your screen before copying."
expected: The hidden-text note disappears (or changes) while the text is shown.
actual: Both contradictory sentences are visible together.
suggested_fix: Render the 'stays hidden' note only while hidden.

criterion: Primary action / disclosure for an alternate path
description: On a second computer, the dominant button on the identity step is "Continue as <name>", which creates a separate duplicate identity; the correct action for this persona, "Link this device instead", is a small inline text link below it. One wrong click leads to STORY-018's dead end.
expected: Present the two choices more evenly (e.g. 'New to Pardner' vs 'I already use Pardner on another computer') before the identity form, or confirm before creating an identity when a device link might be intended.
actual: Primary full-width button vs small underlined link.
suggested_fix: Raise 'Link this device' to a secondary button of equal width, or ask 'Is this your first computer with Pardner?' first.

description: A used invitation's history row says only "My device · Used", without when or by which device it was used.
suggested_fix: Include the recipient device name and the time used.
